cases.rationale: The foreground man and a seated background diner are actual people. An orange chair edge/support is visible beside the background diner, and the foreground eating surface is a dining table. The yellow ridged food being held resembles corn rather than bread with sandwich filling, a frankfurter, donut or cake; the white foreground item is a takeout container rather than an identifiable bowl or cup. The necklace is not a tie. I considered each of the 75 definitions across the whole crop; no other defined object is identifiable and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The crowd and central man are actual people. The overhead deck has skateboard trucks and small wheels, establishing a skateboard rather than a snowboard or surfboard. Dark pack bodies worn behind shoulders in the left-side crowd establish backpacks. The red-and-white neck fabric is a scarf, not a necktie. I considered each of the 75 definitions; the sky, clothing and background structures supply no other identifiable category object. No unresolved category ambiguity.

A wooden garden bench has a long slatted seat, back and two arms; this is a multiple-person bench rather than an individual chair or upholstered couch. The surrounding vegetation grows in the garden without identifiable pots, so it is not potted plant presence. I considered each of the 75 definitions across the whole crop; no other defined object is visible and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual man crouches beside the creek holding an orange flying disc by its rim. Its shallow round disc shape and throwing grip establish a frisbee rather than a plate or bowl. Grass, water, twigs and clothing do not identify any further category. I considered each of the 75 definitions; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The split baguette portions support meat and condiment filling, establishing sandwich portions rather than pizza, hot dog, cake or plain bread. A partial open sauce bowl is visible at the upper left. Small metallic pieces cut off by the top edge could be a knife and spoon, but their blade/handle and bowl/handle structures are insufficiently complete: knife and spoon remain unclear. The wooden surface is a cutting board, not evidence of a dining table. I considered all 75 definitions; the remaining categories lack identifiable objects.

The set eating table and single-person chairs are identifiable. Place settings include handled cups on saucers, stemmed wine glasses, and metal forks, knives and spoons; flat plates are excluded from bowl. The rear counter contains an open fruit bowl, and the kitchen has a conventional oven beneath the cooktop and a sink with faucet. Tiny yellow/red fruit forms in the rear bowl do not resolve banana or apple identity, so those two are unclear. A small upright counter item near the sink is insufficiently detailed to confirm a bottle, also unclear. Red doors alone are cabinets rather than an identifiable refrigerator; no microwave is established. I considered all 75 definitions, with the remaining categories absent.

An actual black cat stands in the metal sink, whose basin and faucet are visible. Hanging kitchen knives have dark handles and downward metal blades, and the utensil holder contains an identifiable wooden spoon with oval bowl and handle. The perforated colander and sink are not ordinary bowls, and the utensil cylinder is not a drinking cup or vase. The tiny yellow/green item beside the faucet could be a soap bottle, but its body and neck are not resolved, so bottle remains unclear. I considered each of the 75 definitions; no other defined category is identifiable.

Actual spectators and a rider are visible, along with the rider's brown-and-white horse. A red pickup with cab and bed is a truck; the attached livestock trailer is not a bus or passenger car. The overhead triangular pennants are flags rather than flying kites, and the bleachers do not supply an identifiable bench seat in this small crop. I considered each of the 75 definitions; no further category object is identifiable and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The plate holds identifiable broccoli florets and shrimp, with a lemon wedge rather than an orange. A metal eating fork has distinct tines and handle at the upper right. The plate is flat, not a bowl. A partial transparent stem and round foot at the top suggest a stemmed glass, but its bowl is outside the crop, leaving wine-glass form unclear under the frozen definition. The underlying surface lacks enough table structure or context to establish a dining table. I considered all 75 definitions; no remaining category is identifiable.

An actual child stands on the field raising a brown leather baseball fielding glove with a deep pocket and finger sections. This is a fielding mitt, not a batting glove or merely an inferred baseball accessory. Grass, the field boundary and distant building do not establish additional defined objects. I considered each of the 75 definitions; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

Three actual people are visible. The foreground player holds a white handheld game remote, with its narrow buttoned body and wrist strap establishing remote control. The right upholstered seat is a couch and the left recliner is an individual chair. A tall plant rises from a dark planter at the left edge, and a round wall clock is above the recliner. A dark cropped foreground object at lower left may be the television receiving the remote input, but insufficient screen/frame structure is visible, so TV is unclear rather than inferred from use. I considered all 75 definitions; no other defined category is identifiable.

An actual child holds a white handheld game remote with its buttoned body and wrist strap. The standalone television has a visible frame and base; the cartoon people and animals on its screen are excluded as actual category instances. The stand is an electronics cabinet rather than a dining table, and the shelf cases are media cases rather than identifiable bound books. The fan, loudspeaker, game equipment and wheeled toy do not match other definitions. I considered each of the 75 definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.
